title: flowchart: click 網址簡寫不收 tooltip 與 target（click B "url" "tip" / _blank）

v:
撰寫 `skills/siren` 時量到。

## 事實

三種寫法，mermaid 11.17.2（`pnpm --filter siren-core probe`，含 `--markup`）**全部接受**：

| 寫法 | Mermaid | Siren |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `click B "https://x.com" "tip"` | 接受，B 帶 `clickable`，節點 `title="tip"` | `Unrecognized flowchart line`，整份沒有圖 |
| `click B "https://x.com" _blank` | 接受，B 帶 `clickable` | 同上 |
| `click B "https://x.com" "tip" _blank` | 接受，B 帶 `clickable`，`title="tip"` | 同上 |

帶 `href` 關鍵字的完整寫法 `click B href "url" "tip" _blank` Siren 已經支援。**只有省略 `href` 的簡寫停在一個參數。**

## 原因

`parseFlowchart.ts` 的 `CLICK_HREF_BARE_RE = /^click\s+(ID)\s+"([^"]*)"$/`（約 1239 行）只收網址本身；它的註解寫明 tooltip/linkTarget 都是 `null`。簡寫實作時（`click A "url" bare href shorthand` 那張票）只量了單參數形式。

## 要自己量的

probe 的 `--markup` 輸出沒有印出 `<a>`，所以 **href 與 target 最後落在哪裡這次沒量到**，只確認了三種寫法都被接受、tooltip 生效。實作前要量：

1. 簡寫的 tooltip 與 target 是否與 `click B href "url" "tip" _blank` 產生完全相同的結果（預期是，但要量）。
2. `click B "url" _blank` 的 `_blank` 是被當成 target，還是被當成什麼別的東西。

## 修法方向

若第 1 點成立，簡寫應該直接走 `CLICK_HREF_RE` 的後半段：放寬 `CLICK_HREF_BARE_RE` 接上與 `CLICK_HREF_RE` 相同的可選 tooltip 與 target，產生同一個 `Interaction`。

## 驗收

- 語料庫新增三列 `supported`，assert 讀渲染出的 `<a>` 的 href、target 與 title。
- `skills/siren/references/syntax.md`「The shorthand `click X "url"` takes neither」一句改掉。

## 驗證指令

- `pnpm --filter siren-core test`

# 04 The flowchart click URL shorthand takes a tooltip and target, and tooltips are drawn

nook: 01M3NK40861WY7AJ6NRNSSV8AZ

## Outcome

`click B "url" "tip"`, `click B "url" _blank` and `click B "url" "tip" _blank` render, and every
flowchart click tooltip (shorthand or full `href` form) appears as a native SVG tooltip.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each of the three shorthand forms renders with no diagnostics and produces the same
      `<a>` (href, target, rel) as the equivalent `click B href "url" ...` form.
- [ ] A flowchart click with a tooltip — `href` form, shorthand, or `call` form — draws a
      `<title>` as the first child of the node group, with the tooltip as text content
      (never parsed as markup), matching the class diagram renderer's convention.
- [ ] A click without a tooltip draws no `<title>`.
- [ ] Non-URL shorthand values stay rejected by the existing `resolveInteractions` allowlist.
- [ ] Corpus: `supported` rows for the three shorthand forms whose asserts read href, target
      and the `<title>`.
- [ ] skills/siren/references/syntax.md: replace "The shorthand `click X "url"` takes neither."
      with the shorthand's real form.
- [ ] CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` → Fixed (shorthand) and Added (flowchart tooltips).

## Test seam

`render()` SVG (`<a>` attributes, `<title>`); corpus rows.
